test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11518f4f3fc682cbac7035666db0b97e9fd3f8094c994cbe7037d39c22ce9f5a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18f0aea709cd4b9436645068f46fa24594581019f082fd2666a5e1b7ea8ac7e1.png] 

Here, we have two dices and face number 4 is common in both of them.

Also, both the dice are arranged in such a way that the common faces are at the same place.

So, we can see that, all the numbers except number 1 is not seen here in the image.

Hence, the number __**1**__ will be the face opposite to the face 4.
